arguments.sql:
WITH lab_by_patient AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           COUNT(*) AS lab_rows,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.GPT >= 60) AS high_gpt_rows,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TYPEOF(l.GPT) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null')) AS nonnumeric_gpt_rows
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT p.SEX AS sex_code,
       COUNT(*) AS registered_patients,
       COUNT(b.lab_rows) AS patients_with_lab_rows,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.high_gpt_rows > 0) AS patients_with_high_gpt,
       COALESCE(SUM(b.nonnumeric_gpt_rows), 0) AS nonnumeric_gpt_rows
FROM main.Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN lab_by_patient AS b ON b.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX

WITH sexes(sex_code, sex) AS (
    VALUES ('M', 'Male'), ('F', 'Female')
),
patients_with_high_alt AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.GPT >= 60
)
SELECT s.sex,
       COUNT(p.ID) FILTER (WHERE h.ID IS NULL) AS patient_count
FROM sexes AS s
LEFT JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.SEX = s.sex_code
LEFT JOIN patients_with_high_alt AS h ON h.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY s.sex_code, s.sex
ORDER BY s.sex_code DESC
